written: 2026-10-21, Claude implementation worker (task b73e43dd). Not run: no data, no training, no GPU. Arm N added 2026-10-21 (task fbbf1e4e).

fixed.history_augmentation: dither 6 PWM p 0.5, dropout p 0.1 k 12..15

pipeline.name: convert
pipeline.out: datasets/pairact-r1-<TS>/ (train + validation admitted seeds only; heldout refused)

pipeline.name: stage sidecar
pipeline.stop_if: missing_stages contains any of approach, alignment, ready, execute, carry, place, complete

pipeline.name: train
pipeline.cmd: train_grasp_act.py --stage main --steps 20000 --checkpoint-every 1000 --max-wall-s 25200 --profile-timing --execution-host-profile pairact_r1_l4 (arm F gcp2, arm N gcp6, parallel)

pipeline.name: offline gate + selection
pipeline.data: validation split only (8341000-8341019 admitted); heldout never loaded
pipeline.rule: OFFLINE_GATE.md G1-G5 clean + dithered; pick max min-G4 recall, then G1, then earliest step
pipeline.stop_if: NOT_READY_NO_CHECKPOINT_PASSES -> no P5, report; no threshold change, no heldout look

pipeline.name: freeze
pipeline.out: experiments/2026-10-21-pairact-r1/CHECKPOINT_FREEZE.json, committed and pushed before any heldout rollout

pipeline.name: P5
pipeline.prereg: PAIRACT_R1_EVAL_PREREG_DRAFT.json v2 (status FROZEN, sha in rows header)

tiers.rule: training hyperparameters are identical in every trainable tier (no tier-dependent tuning: it would be a choice made after seeing the yield). Tiers change only labels, the P5 headline and per-bin reporting.

TRAIN.when: A >= 150 and every bin >= 20 (+ validation gate)
TRAIN.p5_headline: student success n/N_eff beside teacher n/N_eff; funnel secondary

TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED.p5_headline: same as TRAIN; heldout seeds whose bin (index % 6) is limited get their own row, never dropped
TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED.label: 데이터 범위 제한(구간 부족: <bins>)

TRAIN_SMALL_DATA.p5_headline: stage funnel n/N_eff per arm is the headline; success n/N_eff still reported and still counts for the r1 minimum
TRAIN_SMALL_DATA.label: 소량 데이터(A<150): 결과 해석은 단계 퍼널 중심으로 제한
TRAIN_SMALL_DATA.note: 20k steps x batch 8 = 160k samples; rows per episode unmeasured [확인 필요] — with ~1000 rows per robot stream, A=80 gives ~160k rows (~1 epoch), A=200 ~400k rows (~0.4 epoch) [추정]

NO_TRAIN.next: A < 80 -> back to P2; others -> report to Claude owner

gpu_estimate.train_h: 4.6 per arm (F gcp2, N gcp6, parallel)
gpu_estimate.basis: DESIGN.md section 3 (beamact2 10k 2.29 h linear, beamact3 20k 2.8-3.6 h)

arms.rule: same collected dataset, same stage sidecar, same hyperparameters and seed; arm N differs only in segment_scope (harness.pairact_r1.assert_arm_pair refuses anything else). Arms train in parallel on two VMs; neither waits for the other.

F.trains: every stage (approach .. hold, carry, door, place, complete)
F.label: 학습 전 구간

N.trains: approach, alignment, READY, grasp, 3 s hold, recover, place (lower/open/raise/retreat), complete
N.excluded: rows whose stage target is carry (teacher carry:carry_hold .. carry:zone_settle = carry + door passage): sampler weight 0, carry horizon entries masked like padding in action/done/stage loss
N.label: 학습 근거리 + 코드 운반(hybrid)
N.evaluated: only with the code carry segment (HYBRID_RUN.md); never as a pure student
N.note: fewer trained rows at the same 20k steps x batch 8 -> more passes over the near-field rows [추정: carry share of rows unmeasured, 확인 필요 from the sidecar]

arms.shared_steps: 1 decision, 2 convert, 3 stage sidecar, 4 smoke (both arms, 300 steps each), 5 approval (one approval.json per arm, same dataset/sidecar sha), 6 train (parallel), 7 offline gate per arm, 8 freeze per arm, 9 P5
arms.vm_swap: if one VM is unavailable, the arms run one after the other on the same VM; the config does not change. Host profile pairact_r1_l4 (scripts/beamact1_runtime.require_pairact_l4) admits ugrp-act-l4-gcp2 and ugrp-act-l4-gcp6 (g2-standard-8) only [확인 필요: gcp6 trainer environment equals gcp2]
